# PRISM (09 · prism)

A glass bank dashboard — animated gradient mesh, live drifting chart, honest axes.

- **Technique:** GLASSMORPHISM

- **Best for:** fintech; SaaS products; dashboards; startups

## Tokens — `theme.css`
Every color and font stack the design uses. Override per site; canvas/WebGL effects read these at init.

```css
/* prism — design tokens. Override any of these per site via `theme` (inline on <html>). */
:root {
  --bg: #0b0e16;
  --glass: rgba(255, 255, 255, .055);
  --glass-brd: rgba(255, 255, 255, .12);
  --mint: #7ce7d8;
  --mint-light: #9ceee2;
  --on-mint: #06251f;
  --vio: #b48bf2;
  --rose: #f28bb4;
  --amber: #f2c94c;
  --tx: #eef2fa;
  --dim: #94a0b8;
  --faint: #525e78;
  --scroll-thumb: #232c42;
  /* background gradient-mesh blobs */
  --blob1: #2b3f8a;
  --blob2: #127a6d;
  --blob3: #6d3b8f;
  --sora: "Sora", sans-serif;
  --mono: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1);
}
```

## Signature effects
- `chart.ts`
  - `initChart(svg: SVGSVGElement)` — Balance line chart: the line draws itself on first render, then a new random-walk point slides in every 1.8s. With reduced motion it renders once, static.
- `countup.ts`
  - `initCountUps(els: Iterable<HTMLElement>)` — Count each element up to its `data-end` the first time 60% of it is visible. Elements with `data-grouped` show thousands separators.
- `donut.ts`
  - `initDonut(svg: SVGSVGElement)` — Spending donut. Reads `data-segments` (JSON `[{ percent, tone }]`), `data-total` and `data-caption` from the SVG; each segment is stroked in its `--<tone>` token.
- `tilt.ts`
  - `initTilt(el: HTMLElement)` — Tilt `el` up to 4deg toward the pointer. No-op under reduced motion.

## Content model — `content.ts`
Every user-visible string lives here. Fields ending in `Html` are trusted inline HTML (`<em> <b> <i> <br> <a> <span>`).

```ts
/** Fields ending in `Html` are trusted, author-written HTML (inline <em>/<b>/<a>/<br> only). */
export interface Link {
  label: string;
  href: string;
}

/** Accent color token a tinted element uses: `--mint`, `--vio`, `--rose` or `--amber`. */
export type Tone = 'mint' | 'vio' | 'rose' | 'amber';

export interface Content {
  seo: { title: string; description: string; ogTitle?: string; ogDescription?: string };
  /** Wordmark text beside the prism logo mark in nav + footer. */
  brand: string;
  /** Top-bar text links; each href targets a section id. */
  nav: Link[];
  /** Pill button at the end of the top bar. */
  navCta: Link;
  hero: {
    /** `<em>` renders as the mint-to-rose gradient. */
    headingHtml: string;
    sub: string;
    primary: Link;
    secondary: Link;
    trust: string;
    /** The mock dashboard beside the headline. */
    dashboard: {
      balance: {
        label: string;
        currency: string;
        /** Whole-unit amount the counter animates up to (shown with thousands separators). */
        amount: number;
        /** Fixed fractional part including the dot, e.g. ".42". */
        cents: string;
        delta: string;
      };
      spending: {
        label: string;
        /** Total printed in the donut centre. */
        total: string;
        /** Small caption under the total. */
        caption: string;
        /** Segments in order; percentages should sum to 100. */
        categories: { name: string; percent: number; tone: Tone }[];
      };
      activity: {
        label: string;
        transactions: {
          /** Glyph in the tinted badge. */
          icon: string;
          tone: Tone;
          who: string;
          amount: string;
          /** Credits render in mint. */
          credit?: boolean;
        }[];
      };
    };
  };
  features: {
    id: string;
    kicker: string;
    /** `<em>` renders as a gradient. */
    headingHtml: string;
    items: { no: string; title: string; body: string; tone: Tone }[];
  };
  numbers: {
    id: string;
    kicker: string;
    /** `<em>` renders as a gradient. */
    headingHtml: string;
    stats: {
      /** Number the counter animates up to. */
      value: number;
      /** Suffix after the number, e.g. "s", "%", "px". */
      unit?: string;
      label: string;
      /** Render the number in mint. */
      highlight?: boolean;
    }[];
  };
  security: {
    id: string;
    kicker: string;
    /** `<em>` renders as a gradient. */
    headingHtml: string;
    /** Band headline; `<br>` allowed. */
    bandHeadingHtml: string;
    body: string;
    cta: Link;
  };
  footer: {
    note: string;
    /** Credit line above the showcase link (`<a>` allowed). */
    creditHtml?: string;
  };
}
```
